reasoning.text:
[p0 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Fresh level1, only click is interactive. Diverse 3-click probe across distinct object classes: an unselected ring block (does click move cursor or recolor?), the left red cross and right cross (are they color sources/targets?). Short to observe semantics before committing.

[p1 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Crosses rotate the invariant-multiset ring; yellow(11) is the unique block and matches the yellow cursor color. Bring yellow into the cursor slot: left-cross(CCW) 5x moves yellow from top idx5 to idx0. Expect reward on the 5th.

[p2 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New #-lattice level. Probe the rotation mechanic cleanly: red row26 cross then green row26 cross (expected inverse like L1). Learn whether a cross rotates only its horizontal row and whether shared vertical-line cells move, before planning the yellow-to-cursor solution.

[p3 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Diagnostic: click top red cross then top green cross. Determine whether the top crosses rotate ONLY the short row r17 (5 blocks) or the whole rectangular PERIMETER loop. This decides whether yellow blocks (r17/idx5, r38/col2) can ever reach the col6 cursor slots -- i.e. whether the synth yellow-to-cursor goal is satisfiable. Pair is invertible so state returns to start.

[s0 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=1 engine=0 accuracy=100.0

[p4 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 verified 8-move solve (BFS + engine.transition_function agree): bring yellow(11) into both cursor slots (3,6)&(6,6). Sequence = peri_grn(39,17),r35_grn(48,35),peri_grn x3,r35_grn x3. Emitting first 5 (4x peri_grn green-CW cross + 1x r35_grn). After move5 expect cursor(3,6)=11,(6,6)=10; then 3 more r35_grn(48,35) finish to 11/11. Engine planner wrongly reported unreachable (it mismodels the (3,6)/(6,6) cells shared by perimeter & row rotors).

[s1 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=2 engine=1 accuracy=100.0

[p5 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L2 finish: board now (3,6)=11,(6,6)=10. BFS from current ground-truth state = 3x r35_grn(48,35) (green CW row35 rotor). Engine transition confirms (6,6)->11 at move3 => both cursor slots yellow(11) = win. Completes the verified 8-move solve.

[p6 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 first probe. Two rotor cross-pairs at bottom (y40-43): LEFT red(x22-24)/green(x25-27), RIGHT red(x34-36)/green(x37-39). Engine rotor-ID is unreliable for L3 (predicts only 8-cell diffs). Click LEFT-red(23,41) then RIGHT-red(35,41) one rotation each to read the real [DIFF] and map which 2x2 blocks each rotor moves. Goal hyp: deliver yellow(11) block to yellow-bracket slot (y28-29,x15-16) and color-12 block to 12-bracket slot (y28-29,x45-46). Need rotor membership before planning the solve.

[s2 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=3 engine=2 accuracy=100.0

[p7 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 verified 15-move all-RED solve via 2-token routing BFS (every single cross move matches engine.transition_function exactly). Goal: route color-11 block to yellow-bracket LEFT slot (15,28) and color-12 block to color12-bracket RIGHT slot (45,28). Full seq: L_red x3,R_red x3,L_red x6,R_red x3 where L_red=(23,41),R_red=(35,41). Emitting first 5 (L_red x3 then R_red x2); will verify token trajectory in log then finish remaining 10.

[s3 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=4 engine=3 accuracy=100.0

[p8 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L3 continue. Tokens tracked EXACTLY as model predicted (11@(33,19),12@(36,37) after first 5 real moves). Remaining solve from current state = R_red, L_red x6, R_red x3. Emitting next 5: R_red(35,41) then L_red(23,41) x4. This advances 11 toward LEFT slot(15,28) and parks 12 near RIGHT loop. Will finish last 5 next call.

[s4 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=5 engine=4 accuracy=100.0

[p9 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 decisive coupling probe. Click TR-left-red cross (36,15). Engine H-A predicts 72 cells changed (20-block rotor = all 4 horizontal arms coupled, 11 block (42,15)->(39,15)). Alternatives: ~40 cells = single row y15 (TL+TR), ~20 cells = H-B (TR arm only, which would make the level unreachable since 11/12 deliverables must reach BR slots). Reading the real [DIFF] determines the true rotor topology before I plan the multi-step solve. Single click to get a clean read.

[s5 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=6 engine=5 accuracy=100.0

[p10 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 H-A CONFIRMED by real probe (step38 matched engine exactly). Two coupled 20-block rotors (H=all horizontal arms, V=all vertical arms) sharing 4 plus-centers. 2-token routing BFS gives 12-move solve V_cw x4 + H_ccw x8 (engine goal_satisfied=True, all moves verified). V_cw=(15,6), H_ccw=(36,15). 12 first sends color-12 down V to its H-row, then H_ccw walks both tokens to targets 11->(45,45),12->(51,45). Emitting first 5: V_cw x4, H_ccw x1.

[p11 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L4 (lvl idx3) step44 ground-truth: token-11@(21,15) on H rotor, token-12@(15,21) on V rotor. Targets: 11->(45,45) shared center, 12->(51,45) H-only slot (cursor_pairs confirmed). Empirically verified at step44 that V-rotor direction is INVERTED vs H (synth run-7 fix live): H_ccw=i-1,H_cw=i+1 but V_ccw=i+1,V_cw=i-1. 2-token BFS gives 9-move solution [H_ccw*4, V_cw*2, H_ccw*3], verified move-by-move vs engine.transition_function ending goal_satisfied=True. Emitting first 5 clicks: H_ccw*4 (click 36,15) brings 11 from (21,15)->(9,15) and parks 12 at staging, then V_cw (click 15,6) advances 12 (15,21)->(15,18). Remaining V_cw*1,H_ccw*3 next call.

[s6 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=7 engine=6 accuracy=100.0

[p12 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New L5: probe top-left red cross R1 (calibrate top-row rotor direction) and mid red cross R2 (learn the unknown lower rotor that must route color-11 blocks up into the two bracketed top-row slots).

[s7 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=8 engine=7 accuracy=100.0

[p13 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L5 solved in-model in 9 moves (BFS on the 21-cyclic snake + 5-cell top-row window). Submitting first 5 (BR,BR,TR,BG,TG) to confirm the inferred green-cross inverse directions before the 4xBG tail.

[s8 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=9 engine=8 accuracy=100.0

[p14 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Final 4 bottom-green (snake roll -1) clicks: moves the two color-11 blocks into both top-row bracket slots (r0c0,r0c4), completing L5. Verified in color sim against observed transitions.

[s9 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=10 engine=9 accuracy=100.0

[p15 | acting_agent | action_plan]
New L6 motif (75 fragmented 2x2 blocks, 7 green CW-only crosses, 3 clustered yellow target slots). Mechanics unverified and synth rotor guess likely wrong. Single-click probe of the top-left green cross (27,15) to read exactly which cells rotate and in what direction before committing a solve plan.

[s10 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=11 engine=10 accuracy=100.0

[p16 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L6 decoded: 3 octagonal bullseyes, each target slot is radius-4 on the spoke aimed at the center. Cross (27,15) only cycles rings1-3, never the slot. Probe the second top-left cross (15,28) to learn whether a different cross on the same bullseye drives a 4-cell spoke (reaching the slot) or behaves differently -- the key to routing yellow into slots.

[s11 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=12 engine=11 accuracy=100.0

[p17 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Both bullseye cross-modes (radial/angular) confirmed but neither touches the r4 target slots, so the carried goal is unreachable as modeled. 6 of 7 crosses are bullseye feeders (2 each); the 7th orphan cross at (53,55) maps to no bullseye and is uniquely shaped -- probe it to find the slot-delivery/routing mechanic.

[s12 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=13 engine=12 accuracy=100.0

[p18 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Route TL yellow S-r2 to SE-r3 via 1 angular(15,28)+1 radial(27,15); start TR with 2 radial(57,15) NE-r1->NE-r3, also verifying TR's inferred radial mode.

[s13 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=14 engine=13 accuracy=100.0

[p19 | acting_agent | action_plan]
TL done (SE r3). TR radial confirmed (yellow at NE r3). Now 4 angular(45,28) rotate TR yellow NE->SW (CCW) to SW r3, its inward slot-spoke; also verifies TR angular mode. Next: BOT routing then delivery(53,55).

[s14 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=15 engine=14 accuracy=100.0

[p20 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Slot2(cluster)=11 already correct; only need 11 moved from row idx6(col38) to idx7(col41=slot1). A green(right) rotation of component-A row does that without touching cluster -> win. Probing top-left GREEN cross as the independent component-A control; if it solves, done, else read exact effect.

[s15 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=16 engine=15 accuracy=100.0

[p21 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L7 win route: both cursor slots need 11. slot2(32,35)=11 already OK; slot1(41,23)=15 needs 11. Full model win = [CG,CG,TG,CR,MR,CR] (bottom-green x2, top-green, bottom-red, mid-red, bottom-red) -> r7=11 & knob k1=11. Issuing verifiable prefix CG,CG,TG to confirm the UNOBSERVED bottom-green coupling (predict after2: row=(11,15,2,1,15,2,1,9), knob=(9,1,15,11)); finish with CR,MR,CR next call.

[s16 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=17 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p22 | acting_agent | action_plan]
CG,CG,TG matched model EXACTLY (row[15,15,2,1,15,2,1,9],col[15,10,11],knob[9,1,15,11]) -> bottom-green coupling + column confirmed. Finish win: CR(29,43 bottom-red),MR(20,33 mid-red),CR(29,43) -> row r7=11 AND knob k1=11 => both cursor slots 11 = WIN.

[p23 | acting_agent | action_plan]
L8 entry, ZERO transitions observed. Single probe of bottom-RED cross (31,57) to classify the cascade rotor: which blocks move, loop-vs-line, and red direction. Board = 4 vertical slot-columns (c7/c9/c11/c13) fed by upper-left diagonals carrying 3 yellow(11) blocks; goal route each yellow into its bottom slot. Read exact diff before any solve.

[s17 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=18 engine=16 accuracy=100.0

[p24 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Probe right-RED top cross (49,24). Synth wrongly models all crosses as one global cascade; that makes L8 unsolvable, so right crosses must give INDEPENDENT per-chain control. One click reveals which chain (if any) it rotates and direction. If only ~14-16 cells of a single chain change, it is the independent control I need to align c7(+5)/c9(+4) without disturbing delivered c11.

[s18 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=19 engine=17 accuracy=100.0

[s19 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=20 engine=18 accuracy=100.0

[p25 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Probe mid-right RED pair to map which diagonal feeder it drives (hyp: c7 or c9) and its direction; longest unknown segment so red vs green differs.

[s20 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=21 engine=19 accuracy=100.0

[p26 | acting_agent | action_plan]
Probe bottom-right RED pair to map c7 feeder segment (expect c7 diagonal arc ~idx8-13) and direction. Completes the operator set so I can build an exact empirical permutation model and BFS a minimal delivery for c7+c9 yellows without disturbing delivered c11.

[p27 | acting_agent | action_plan]
BFS 6-move solve prefix (first 4). Operators all data-confirmed: G_red(31,57) rotates all 3 loops -1; S7_grn(53,34) rotates c7 arc idx7-13 -1; S9_grn(53,29) rotates c9 arc idx10-15 -1. Predicts yellows c7->(3,12) idx13, c9->(6,6) idx15, c11->(21,12) idx13. Verify before final [S11(49,24), G_grn(36,57)] which lands all 3 at slots.

[p28 | acting_agent | action_plan]
CORRECTED model: bottom GREEN(36,57)=global -1 toward slot. Start c7=11,c9=14,c11=2 (probes had moved them; my prev BFS start was stale + global sign flipped). New 8-move BFS: [Ggrn x4, S7grn(53,34), S9grn(53,29), S11(49,24), Gred(31,57)]. Firing 4x Ggrn first to verify global dir+wrap; predict yellows c7(21,30) c9(21,21) c11(21,12) = idx(7,10,13).

[s21 | synthesizer | world_model_version]
round=22 engine=20 accuracy=100.0
